cues.text: The Shadows are gone. In the entrance hall, Fuuka stands with the Evoker clasped in her hands and Natsuki on her knees beside her, as her Persona fades away.
You and the others walk over to them.
Fuuka's eyes close and she collapses to the floor. You and Akihiko kneel beside her, and Natsuki crawls to her side.
Natsuki kneels beside Fuuka, sitting back on her heels with her head bowed, crying.
